references.disposition: Multiplication of probabilities is the field's ordinary numeric product, used here as part of the independence criterion rather than a separate new stochastic operation.
Equality P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B) is the exact defining predicate of independence for this pair and not an additional prerequisite assumption.
No positivity or conditional-probability division hypothesis is needed for the defining product rule.
